claim_scope: For all integers \(n\ge4\), the inclusive unrescaled Euclidean Rips filtration on \(R_n=\{e_i-e_j:i\ne j\}\): complete integral persistence intervals, all rational \(S_n\)-homology characters, and full-symmetry quotient parity.
integrity: The uniform proof is in RESULT.md. Exact finite mod-2 checks and equivariant Lefschetz traces in verify_type_a_rips.py are auxiliary consistency checks, not independent or infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem does not cover \(n=3\), other metrics or root systems, integral quotient torsion, or quotient homotopy type. The published cuboctahedron \(n=4\) specialization and the known \(\operatorname{Hom}(K_2,K_n)\) sphere are not claimed as new. Bibliographic priority and independent validation remain outstanding.
title: Integral Rips persistence and symmetry characters of type-\(A\) root sets
